name_zh: 苏菲/信德/旁遮普圣人/神秘主义/伊斯兰传统
description_zh: 巴基斯坦苏菲传统代表人物，包括信德省的沙·阿卜杜勒·拉提夫·比哈里、旁遮普省的巴哈·乌丁·扎卡里亚等，通过神秘主义、诗歌、音乐传播伊斯兰教义，强调精神内在体验，促进宗教宽容，形成独特的南亚伊斯兰文化传统。
description_en: Pakistani Sufi tradition representatives including Shah Abdul Latif Bhittai of Sindh, Bahauddin Zakariya of Punjab, etc., spread Islamic teachings through mysticism, poetry, music, emphasize spiritual inner experience, promote religious tolerance, form unique South Asian Islamic cultural tradition.
reason_zh: 苏菲传统代表伊斯兰神秘主义如何在南亚形成独特的文化传统，展示了精神追求如何超越政治分歧，其诗歌和音乐影响了巴基斯坦文化认同，其宽容理念促进了宗教和谐，其遗产塑造了南亚伊斯兰文明的独特性。
reason_en: Sufi tradition represents how Islamic mysticism forms unique cultural tradition in South Asia, demonstrates how spiritual pursuits transcend political divisions, its poetry and music influence Pakistani cultural identity, its tolerance理念 promotes religious harmony, its legacy shapes uniqueness of South Asian Islamic civilization.
steps_zh: 研究苏菲主义起源/理论基础/神秘实践
分析信德苏菲诗人/拉提夫诗歌/音乐传统
探讨旁遮普苏菲领袖/扎卡里亚教导/影响范围
评估苏菲传统与现代伊斯兰政治关系
总结苏菲遗产/文化影响/当代意义
steps_en: Analyze Sindh Sufi poets/Latif poetry/musical traditions
Explore Punjab Sufi leaders/Zakariya teachings/influence scope
Evaluate Sufi tradition relationship with modern Islamic politics
expected_zh: 理解伊斯兰神秘主义如何在南亚形成独特文化传统，掌握苏菲精神追求的核心价值，评估苏菲诗歌和音乐的文化影响，认识苏菲传统在当代巴基斯坦的作用。
expected_en: Understand how Islamic mysticism forms unique cultural tradition in South Asia, grasp core values of Sufi spiritual pursuits, evaluate cultural impact of Sufi poetry and music, recognize Sufi tradition role in contemporary Pakistan.
case_zh: 13-18世纪苏菲运动；沙·阿卜杜勒·拉提夫诗歌；巴哈·乌丁·扎卡里亚教导。神秘主义/诗歌传统/宗教宽容/文化认同。
case_en: 13th-18th century Sufi movement; Shah Abdul Latif poetry; Bahauddin Zakariya teachings. Mysticism/Poetic tradition/Religious tolerance/Cultural identity.
cross_cultural_impact: South Asian Islamic culture/Mystical poetry/Music traditions/Religious syncretism/Regional identity
conflict_resolution_mechanism: 精神对话/文化调解/传统权威
